findings.evidence: grep -rn "Nat.pow_right_injective" TauCeti/ → Cyclic.lean:69,75; FreeModule.lean:84; UnitsElementaryTwoQuotient.lean:136, each preceded by the identical `rw [card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow_twoRank] at hcard`.
findings.fix: Add to ElementaryTwoQuotient/Basic.lean a shared `theorem twoRank_eq_of_card_eq [Module.Finite (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient G)] {n} (h : Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) = 2 ^ n) : twoRank G = n` and make all four sites `exact twoRank_eq_of_card_eq (…)`.
findings.issue: The step "|G/G²| = 2^n ⟹ twoRank G = n" (rw card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow_twoRank; exact Nat.pow_right_injective le_rfl hcard) is written out four times in this PR: Cyclic.lean:69, Cyclic.lean:75, FreeModule.lean:84, UnitsElementaryTwoQuotient.lean:136. No such lemma exists in Basic.lean (only the forward direction card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow_twoRank, Basic.lean:314).

findings.evidence: UnitSquares/Basic.lean:55-90 proves ≤ 2^finrank ℚ F via the calc `S.card ≤ rank F + 1 ≤ finrank ℚ F`; the PR's `units_sq_index_eq` gives `= 2 ^ (rank F + 1)`, so the same calc step yields the bound directly.
findings.fix: Reprove `units_sq_index_le` as `(units_sq_index_eq F).trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) h)` with `h : rank F + 1 ≤ finrank ℚ F` extracted from the existing inline calc (UnitSquares/Basic.lean:84-90), and derive `units_sq_index_rat_le_two`/`card_units_elementaryTwoQuotient_rat_le_two` from `units_sq_index_rat` by `le_of_eq`. No import cycle: the new file does not import UnitSquares/Basic.
findings.issue: `units_sq_index_eq` makes the existing 35-line generating-set proof of `units_sq_index_le` (closure of fundSystem ∪ ⟨ζ⟩ plus index_square_le_of_closure_eq_top) a redundant second derivation of the same bound; likewise `units_sq_index_rat_le_two` (line 115) and `card_units_elementaryTwoQuotient_rat_le_two` (line 157) are now strictly weaker restatements of the PR's `units_sq_index_rat`. The PR adds the exact value without collapsing them.

summary: The new material is not duplicated by Mathlib, but the PR repeats the same card→twoRank derivation four times instead of factoring it into Basic, and it leaves the pre-existing bespoke proof of units_sq_index_le (and its rat corollaries) standing when the new exact index makes them one-line corollaries.
